title: SN Sexual Memories
tagline: Every OStim or SexLab scene becomes a memory for those who took part and for a bystander who saw it, NPCs talk about it, and a relationship map shows what lies between the people around you.
description:
**For adult players.** A SkyrimNet add-on for OStim Standalone or SexLab (P+ or 1.6x).

Every intimate scene is remembered and talked about, by SkyrimNet's AI, and the people around you have more to say.

**This mod keeps adding features that make your world livelier and chattier.** Each of them sends extra requests to your LLM. If things get too busy, or you are watching your LLM costs, turn features off in the MCM.

## Memories of the scene
When a scene ends, each character who took part, the player included, gets a first-person memory of it, stored as their own SkyrimNet memory. The AI first judges what the encounter was for each of them (loving, casual, paid, a duty, reluctant or forced) from what happened before and during it; whether it was consensual is judged first from what was said just before the scene, and sex is not taken as affection. The memory says who took part, where and when, what happened (the animations, the acts, who climaxed), what was said around it, and how they felt and how the others seemed to feel. NPCs then recall it in later conversations like anything else they lived through. Its AI model is set in SkyrimNet's dashboard: AI > Models, sn_sexual_memories_memory; left empty, SkyrimNet's default model.

## A witness remembers too
One bystander who saw the scene, picked at random among the NPCs nearby with the scene in sight, gets a memory of whom they saw, doing what, and how they took it, true to their own character and their relationship with those involved. When nobody saw it, nobody gets a memory.

## Diary entries after scenes (off by default)
After a scene, everyone who took part, the player too, writes a private diary entry in their own voice, stored as their SkyrimNet diary entry. It does not retell the scene: it is what they never say aloud, how things have changed with the others over their history together, what they mean to do next, and how they see their life, unflattering thoughts included. One more request per person per scene. Its AI model is set at AI > Models, sn_sexual_memories_diary; left empty, SkyrimNet's default model. SkyrimNet's usual diary entries may cover the same scene.

## Lines during scenes
Every so often an NPC in a running scene says a line about what is happening, written and voiced by SkyrimNet. In a forced scene, the one it is done to never sounds willing; when the conversation just before the scene shows they agreed to it, they play it as a willing partner, even in a dominating or rough scene. With OStimNet installed, the lines use its description of the scene.

## Complaints about a partner
Now and then an NPC near you who has a husband, wife or lover complains to you about them, only while that partner is too far away to overhear.

## Your character speaks up (off by default)
Now and then your character says something to an NPC nearby, drawing on what just happened, on your character's memories and on how the two of you stand. The NPC answers, and the line is shown as a subtitle.

## Relationship map
Press a key (Y by default), choose yourself or an NPC nearby, take anyone you do not want off the list, and press Create: SkyrimNet's AI writes what lies between them and up to ten people around you, from both sides' memories, their diaries and SkyrimNet's events, and only from those. Nothing is sent to the AI until you press Create. Each person gets a card: what happened between them, how each feels about the other, the key events and their ties to the others. Cards of people from earlier maps of the same person are kept, folded and dated. Maps are saved per save, and can be remade in English. Needs Magelight UI or Prisma UI; with Phantasm, faces are shown. Its AI model is set in SkyrimNet's dashboard: AI > Models, sn_sexual_memories_relmap; left empty, the map uses SkyrimNet's default model.

## Settings
An MCM turns each feature on or off and sets how often it happens, and how much the relationship map reads. The memories of the participants are always made, with an importance of at least 0.8.

## In the dashboard
The memories made by this mod show "[Sexual Memories]" or "[Sexual Memories / Witness]" after the emotion in the memory list. Its diary entries are tagged sexual_history and sex.

## Requirements
SKSE64, Address Library, SkyrimNet with an AI model set up, OStim Standalone or SexLab, SkyUI and MCM Helper. Optional: OStimNet; Magelight UI or Prisma UI for the relationship map; Phantasm for its faces. It adds no prompt that replaces one of SkyrimNet's own.

## Known limits
Tested on Skyrim 1.6.1170 with SkyrimNet 1.2.0. The installer offers the settings menu in English or Japanese; the memories are written in the language your game's SkyrimNet uses.

changelog:
**Added**
- **Diary entries after scenes (off by default).** Turn it on in the MCM ("Diary entries after scenes"). After a scene, everyone who took part, the player too, writes a private diary entry in their own voice, stored as their SkyrimNet diary entry. It does not retell the scene (the scene memory keeps that): it is what they never say aloud, how things have changed with the others over their history together, what they mean to do next, and how they see their life so far and where it is going, unflattering thoughts included.
  - One more request to your LLM per person per scene.
  - Its model is set in SkyrimNet's dashboard: AI > Models, sn_sexual_memories_diary (this mod's own card, not SkyrimNet's diary model). Left empty, it uses SkyrimNet's default model. To try it out, we recommend an inexpensive model there.
  - When SkyrimNet also writes its usual diary entries, the same scene may appear in both.
  - An entry can fail to be written (the model may decline or give an unusable answer, the request may fail, or SkyrimNet may refuse it, for example while a save is still loading). Then that person gets no entry for that scene; the scene memories are not affected.

**Changed**
- **The scene memories have their own model card:** AI > Models, sn_sexual_memories_memory, used for the participants' and the witness's memories. Left empty, it uses SkyrimNet's default model, as before.
